thread:
sarah_p: Quick sync — marketplace partner reported a perf/regression on their image after we moved to CUDA 12.2 on their VM fleet. They want a formal gating protocol so future driver/CUDA/ROCm bumps don't break marketplace images.

hiro_t: Ack. Can you paste the failure logs? is it just kernel mismatch or a runtime symbol error?

sarah_p: Here's the short snippet from the partner: 
```
E tensorflow: unspecified launch failure 
libcudart.so.12: undefined symbol: cuLaunchKernel_v2
```
They repro only on 5 of their older nodes.

lucas_r: sounds like a mixed driver/runtime issue — some hosts have nvidia 525, some 535. We need to standardize allowed (driver, cuda, kernel) tuples for marketplace images.

nate_ops: Agree. Proposal: create a minimal gate matrix we run in staging that covers: (driver versions x CUDA major) x Ubuntu kernels (lts, latest). Fast smoke tests: container startup, sample infer, nvml checks.

sarah_p: Partner expects a documented process they can reference in marketplace listing for pinned compatibility. Also want a hotfix path if we discover a regression after publish.

hiro_t: Suggestion: maintain two artifact tags per image: `stable-<cuda_major>` (pinned to certified driver set) and `latest-compat` (for experimental). Marketplace should only reference `stable-` images.

deploy-bot: new release checklist triggered — release/marketplace-image/cuda-12.2 -> job 9845 queued

lucas_r: For the playbook, we should include: required driver version range, kernel versions tested, minimal repro test (script), rollback steps, and partner communication template. I can draft the checklist.

sarah_p: Great. Also need SLA for triage: partner-facing ack within 2 business hours, triage/update within 24 hours for blocking regressions. Ops to run hotfix image build within 8 hours after triage signoff.

nate_ops: I can automate the validation matrix job in CI — need the matrix file. Example (WIP): 
```yaml
matrix:
  drivers: [525, 535, 540]
  cuda: [11.8, 12.1, 12.2]
  kernels: [5.15, 6.1]
tests:
  - smoke_start
  - nvml_query
  - sample_infer
```
I'll wire results to the marketplace dashboard.

partners-bot: Created partner-ticket #3487 (Partner: CloudX) and linked to internal issue INF-6721.

sarah_p: Action items:
- lucas_r: draft gating playbook + partner template (EOD)
- nate_ops: implement matrix job and add dashboard hooks (48h)
- hiro_t: produce certified (driver, cuda, kernel) matrix for current images (24h)
- me: share template with partner and confirm they will point to `stable-<cuda_major>` tag

hiro_t: I'll start collecting the cert matrix. Quick Q: do we want to include ROCm variants in the same doc or separate?

lucas_r: Keep ROCm separate but link them. ROCm has different kernel constraints; better a dedicated section.

sarah_p: Cool. If no objections I'll send the partner the initial template after lucas uploads it. Thanks all :thumbsup:

hiro_t: no objections.

nate_ops: On it. I'll post the CI job link once created.

lucas_r: drafting now, will ping when uploaded.

deploy-bot: job 9845 started: validation-matrix (estimate ~18m)

sarah_p: closing for now, will reopen if partner sees anything new.
